summary: Master liquidity risk management with our comprehensive training course. Equip yourself with the tools to mitigate risks and ensure financial stability.
lede: Liquidity risk management helps financial institutions assess whether cash and collateral can meet obligations in normal and stressed conditions. Designed for experienced financial professionals overseeing funding and balance sheets, the course develops practical skills in forecasting behavioral cash flows, measuring liquidity gaps, optimizing high-quality liquid asset buffers, designing stress scenarios and contingency funding plans, and monitoring intraday liquidity.
audienceIntro: This program is designed for experienced financial professionals who are responsible for the solvency, funding strategy, and regulatory alignment of their institutions.
audience: ALM Analysts focused on balance sheet optimization
outcomes: Basel III Liquidity Coverage Ratio Analysis
modules: Liquidity Risk Landscape and Regulatory Foundations
Liquidity Measurement and Cash Flow Forecasting
Basel III Ratio Implementation and HQLA Optimization
Advanced Liquidity Stress Testing and Scenario Design
Intraday Liquidity and Payment System Risk
Funds Transfer Pricing and Liquidity Cost Allocation
Contingency Funding Plans and Crisis Management
Liquidity Governance, Reporting, and Strategy Integration
prerequisites: Participants should have a minimum of 3-5 years of experience in risk management, treasury, or financial reporting. A working knowledge of basic balance sheet mechanics and familiarity with the Basel III framework is required. No programming skills are necessary, but proficiency in Microsoft Excel for financial modeling exercises is essential.
